crossRefs.note: As he said these things, all his adversaries were disappointed and all the multitude rejoiced for all the glorious…
They weren’t able to trap him in his words before the people. They marveled at his answer and were silent.
They didn’t dare to ask him any more questions.
for I will give you a mouth and wisdom which all your adversaries will not be able to withstand or to contradict.
They weren’t able to withstand the wisdom and the Spirit by which he spoke.

translations.web: They couldn’t answer him regarding these things.
translations.bsb: And they were unable to answer these questions.
translations.kjv: And they could not answer him again to these things.
translations.asv: And they could not answer again unto these things.
